sloka: दशग्रीवो महातेजा राजा वैश्रवणानुजः।भीमकर्मा महोत्साहो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ।। ६.७१.२७ ।।
transliteration: daśagrīvo mahātejā rājā vaiśravaṇānujaḥ।bhīmakarmā mahotsāho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ।। 6.71.27 ।।

translations.english: "The tenheaded and highly brilliant king Ravana, who is the brother of Vysravana, is of terrible deeds and highly exploitative."
